notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Storm of Souls.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Storm of Souls.
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
